paragraphs.en: OpenRig is open-source software for building and running your own network of agents. It turns AI coding agents from a pile of terminal sessions into a persistent, organized team. Talk to a lead agent about the outcome you want; it can coordinate specialists across teams and bring you results and decisions that need your attention. Start with a repository and one useful change, then keep the team's work and context at the same addresses.
paragraphs.zh: OpenRig 是用于构建和运行你自己的智能体网络的开源软件。 它把 AI 编码智能体从一堆终端会话变成一个持久、有条理的团队。 向一个主管智能体说明你想要的结果；它可以跨团队协调专家智能体，为你带来需要你关注的结果和决策。 从一个代码仓库和一个有用的改动开始，然后把团队的工作和上下文保存在相同的地址。

paragraphs.en: Requires Node.js 22 or 24 and tmux, on macOS or Linux, and one working Claude Code or Codex account: one is enough, since the kernel operator adapts the shipped starter team to whichever you have. On Linux, the distribution's own Node.js can be older (Ubuntu 24.04's is 18); install a supported version with nvm ( nvm install 22 ) or NodeSource. On a Mac with Apple silicon, use Node.js 22 ( compatibility history ). On a Mac where you aren't an administrator, or where Homebrew belongs to another account (its brew install is refused), install Node.js in your own home folder with nvm : run touch ~/.zshrc (a new Mac account has none, and nvm's installer only adds itself to a profile file that already exists), then nvm's install command, for nvm v0.40.8 curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.8/install.sh | bash ( nvm's page has the newest), open a new terminal, and run nvm install 22 . nvm itself needs no administrator password, and npm install -g then installs into your nvm folder. If nvm's installer says you need Apple's command line tools, run xcode-select --install , then its install command again. On Windows, use WSL2, the Windows route OpenRig supports; native Windows isn't supported. OpenRig's automated tests don't run on WSL2 yet; see one user's working setup .
paragraphs.zh: 需要 Node.js 22 或 24、tmux，运行在 macOS 或 Linux 上，以及一个可用的 Claude Code 或 Codex 账号：有一个就够了，因为内核操作员会根据你拥有的账号来适配随附的初始团队。 在 Linux 上，发行版自带的 Node.js 可能较旧（Ubuntu 24.04 的是 18）；请用 nvm（ nvm install 22 ）或 NodeSource 安装受支持的版本。 在搭载 Apple 芯片的 Mac 上，请使用 Node.js 22（兼容性历史）。 在你不是管理员、或 Homebrew 属于另一个账号（其 brew install 被拒绝）的 Mac 上，请用 nvm 将 Node.js 安装到你自己的主目录中：先运行 touch ~/.zshrc（新的 Mac 账号没有该文件，而 nvm 的安装程序只会把自己添加到已存在的配置文件中），然后运行 nvm 的安装命令，对于 nvm v0.40.8 即 curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/v0.40.8/install.sh | bash（ nvm 的页面上有最新版本），接着打开一个新终端，运行 nvm install 22 。nvm 本身不需要管理员密码，npm install -g 随后会安装到你的 nvm 文件夹中。 如果 nvm 的安装程序提示你需要 Apple 的命令行工具，请运行 xcode-select --install ，然后再次运行其安装命令。 在 Windows 上，请使用 WSL2，这是 OpenRig 支持的 Windows 路径；不支持原生 Windows。 OpenRig 的自动化测试尚不能在 WSL2 上运行；可参考一位用户的可用配置。

paragraphs.en: Choose the working account you already have: Claude Code, Codex, or both . Reuse an explicit choice; no second subscription is required. rig setup --dry-run previews the broader setup; applying rig setup checks both harnesses and installs a missing one, plus Herdr unless declined with --no-herdr . Pass the choice with --providers claude or --providers codex so the other reads not selected instead of failed. The one-command install above doesn't know the choice, so it installs and checks both; for one provider, go step by step and run rig setup --providers <choice> . On macOS, the installing agent offers Ghostty once. Setup leaves an existing cmux installation alone. It is optional for the selected-provider path .
paragraphs.zh: 选择你已有的工作账户：Claude Code、Codex，或两者都用。 复用明确的选择；无需第二个订阅。rig setup --dry-run 可预览更全面的设置；执行 rig setup 会检查两个 harness 并安装缺失的那个，同时还会安装 Herdr，除非用 --no-herdr 拒绝。 通过 --providers claude 或 --providers codex 传递该选择，这样未选中的项会显示为“未选择”而不是“失败”。 上面的一键安装命令并不知道该选择，因此会同时安装并检查两者；若只想要其中一个 provider，请逐步操作并运行 rig setup --providers <choice>。 在 macOS 上，安装智能体只会推荐一次 Ghostty。 设置过程不会改动已有的 cmux 安装。 在选择单一 provider 的路径下，该步骤是可选的。

paragraphs.en: A team seat with no permission policy, per-seat choice or (for Codex) named profile launches with OpenRig's team default : Claude runs ordinary rig commands, project reads and common tests without prompting, while lifecycle commands such as rig up and rig down still ask; Codex also gets the OpenRig workspace and its pod's state directory as writable directories. Before launching, your agent recommends keeping that default, and offers to remember selected OpenRig commands in your native settings only if you want that, at personal project scope unless you explicitly choose user-wide sessions. It is not global YOLO or permission to invent work. On Yes, the agent adds and verifies native rules ; No or no answer keeps the team default and leaves settings unchanged. An existing explicit choice is reused. Say “Undo the OpenRig command allowances added by this setup” to remove only its additions.
paragraphs.zh: 未配置权限策略、未选择按席位配置、或（对于 Codex）未命名配置文件的团队席位，将以 OpenRig 的团队默认设置启动：Claude 可以在无需提示的情况下执行常规 rig 命令、项目读取和常见测试，而 rig up 和 rig down 等生命周期命令仍会询问；Codex 还会将 OpenRig 工作区及其 pod 的状态目录作为可写目录。 在启动之前，你的智能体会建议保留该默认设置，并且仅在你需要时才提供在你本地设置中记住所选的 OpenRig 命令，除非你明确选择用户级会话，否则范围限定在个人项目。 这不是全局的 YOLO 模式，也不是随意创建工作的权限。 选择 Yes 时，智能体会添加并验证本地规则；选择 No 或未回答则保留团队默认设置，且不更改任何设置。 已存在的明确选择会被复用。 只需说「撤销本次设置添加的 OpenRig 命令许可」，即可仅移除其添加的内容。

paragraphs.en: To launch the starter yourself instead (the manual path, without the operator):

paragraphs.en: Managed launches supply HOME , CODEX_HOME and OPENRIG_* identity/connection variables. Claude uses --permission-mode acceptEdits and defaults to the classic renderer for terminal scrollback. Codex uses -s workspace-write unless a named profile governs its sandbox; the default does not force an approval-policy flag. On that plain launch OpenRig first asks Codex for its own configuration and adds -c sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true only when Codex answers that no configuration layer sets network access and no managed requirement could restrict it, so the seat can reach the local daemon. If Codex can't be asked or doesn't answer in time, the launch is left unchanged. Fresh Codex launches also add writable access to the workspace's .git and the pod's shared queue-state directory with --add-dir ; the shared root comes from OPENRIG_SHARED_DOCS_ROOT or ~/.openrig/shared-docs . A team seat with no permission policy, per-seat choice or (for Codex) named profile also gets the per-launch team default: Claude gets --settings allowing ordinary rig commands, project reads and common tests, with a session-only PreToolUse hook that asks before lifecycle commands, and Codex also gets the OpenRig workspace root as a writable directory. Neither writes a permission file. Seats of the rig named kernel launch with an operational default instead, unless a permission policy, a per-seat choice or (for Codex) a named profile applies: Claude in acceptEdits with a per-launch allow list for its file tools, web fetches and operational commands (including reads under your home folder), and Codex with -s danger-full-access -a never . Neither writes a permission file. YOLO is off by default . An explicitly selected full-bypass policy selects Claude's --dangerously-skip-permissions or Codex's -s danger-full-access -a never . The legacy environment-only OPENRIG_YOLO=1 path, with no policy attached, selects Claude's bypass flag, Pi's --approve and Codex's -s danger-full-access without -a never ; a resolved policy overrides that environment setting. The builtin:auto policy launches Claude with --permission-mode auto ; Codex and Pi seats launch as they do without a policy (a named Codex profile still governs its sandbox, and Pi keeps its configured resource trust).
paragraphs.zh: 托管启动会提供 HOME、CODEX_HOME 以及 OPENRIG_* 身份与连接变量。 Claude 使用 --permission-mode acceptEdits，并默认使用经典渲染器来处理终端回滚缓冲。 Codex 使用 -s workspace-write，除非某个具名 profile 管控其沙箱；默认情况下不会强制指定 approval-policy 标志。 在该普通启动中，OpenRig 首先向 Codex 询问其自身配置，仅当 Codex 回答没有任何配置层设置网络访问、且没有任何受管需求可能对其加以限制时，才会添加 -c sandbox_workspace_write.network_access=true，以便该席位可以访问本地守护进程。 如果无法询问 Codex 或其未及时回答，则保持启动配置不变。 全新启动的 Codex 还会通过 --add-dir 添加对工作区 .git 目录和该 pod 共享队列状态目录的可写访问；共享根目录来自 OPENRIG_SHARED_DOCS_ROOT 或 ~/.openrig/shared-docs。 没有权限策略、没有逐席位选择、也没有（对 Codex 而言）具名 profile 的团队席位，还会获得逐次启动的团队默认配置：Claude 获得 --settings，允许普通 rig 命令、项目读取和常见测试，并带有一个仅在会话内生效的 PreToolUse 钩子，在执行生命周期命令前进行询问；Codex 还会获得 OpenRig 工作区根目录作为可写目录。 两者都不会写入权限文件。 名为 kernel 的 rig 的席位会改用操作性默认配置启动，除非适用某个权限策略、逐席位选择或（对 Codex 而言）具名 profile：Claude 处于 acceptEdits 模式，并带有针对其文件工具、网络抓取和操作性命令（包括读取你主目录下的内容）的逐次启动允许列表；Codex 则使用 -s danger-full-access -a never。 两者都不会写入权限文件。YOLO 默认关闭。 显式选择的完全绕过策略会选择 Claude 的 --dangerously-skip-permissions 或 Codex 的 -s danger-full-access -a never。 旧式的仅环境变量路径 OPENRIG_YOLO=1，在不附带任何策略时，会选择 Claude 的绕过标志、Pi 的 --approve 以及 Codex 的 -s danger-full-access（不带 -a never）；已解析的策略会覆盖该环境设置。 builtin:auto 策略会以 --permission-mode auto 启动 Claude；Codex 和 Pi 席位则按没有策略时的方式启动（具名的 Codex profile 仍然管控其沙箱，Pi 也保留其已配置的资源信任）。

paragraphs.en: Permission mode controls native execution permissions; work posture is separate project guidance. Use rig policy permissions list|show|current|apply for rig policy configuration (the four rig policy aliases remain compatible). Use rig seat set-permissions <seat> --mode <mode> --reason <text> for an audited future-launch choice: floor , full_bypass , or inherit to clear the seat override. Additional Claude modes such as auto require support from the exact managed Claude executable at the seat's working directory; selection and launch each check it. Unsupported or changed contexts refuse without a fallback. This does not relaunch the seat or change its current native process, history, rules or hooks. rig seat status separates the desired selection from the last launch arguments; neither proves native enforcement. See the permission guide .

paragraphs.en: Managed hook blocks target OpenRig's entries and retain unrelated hooks, but trust entries and selected resource keys can be replaced. Claude's collector, activity-hook and JSON resource writers leave unreadable or malformed settings untouched; this is not a product-wide preservation guarantee. Codex's workspace trust writer can treat an unreadable config.toml as empty and write a new trust configuration. Read-modify-write operations can also race other writers; there is no complete preservation or rollback guarantee. Back up relevant files before first use. Daemon/bootstrap writes are automatic and do not each have an interactive preview; rig setup --dry-run does not preview every later startup effect.

paragraphs.en: OpenRig is a multi-agent harness — it manages the system that coding agents form when you run them together. Not the agents themselves, but the team they create: which sessions are running, how they relate, how to recover after a reboot, and how to stop it from becoming terminal sprawl.

paragraphs.en: Every phase emits JSON. Stop on any issue or incomplete receipt and follow its next action; do not continue from copied legacy telemetry or retry a partial mutation blindly. Preparation leaves legacy state and collector settings in place. Verification accepts exact tail bytes only when that same seat has newer paired context and provider samples under state/ ; finalization revalidates the accepted tails, copies the library without overwrite, and switches config last. The helper never removes the legacy telemetry or library. Retirement follows separate stable runtime, writer, reader, and recovery proof. Daemon, database, seat, plugin, and release lifecycle actions remain agent-owned.
paragraphs.zh: 每个阶段都输出 JSON。 遇到任何问题或不完整的回执即停止，并执行其对应的下一步操作；不要基于复制的旧版遥测数据继续，也不要盲目重试部分变更。 准备阶段会保留旧版状态和收集器设置不动。 验证阶段仅在同一 seat 在 state/ 下拥有更新的成对上下文和提供方采样时才接受精确的尾部字节；收尾阶段会重新校验已接受的尾部、以不覆盖方式复制库，并最后切换配置。 辅助工具绝不删除旧版遥测数据或库。 弃用需依据各自独立的稳定运行时、写入器、读取器和恢复证明进行。 守护进程、数据库、seat、插件和发布生命周期操作仍由智能体负责。

paragraphs.en: Before setup or managed launch, review what OpenRig changes on your machine , including provider trust, hooks and selected runtime resources.
paragraphs.zh: 在安装或托管启动之前，请先了解 OpenRig 会在你的机器上做出哪些更改，包括对提供商的信任、钩子以及所选的运行时资源。

paragraphs.en: Already-running adopted sessions may need restart before they pick up newly written runtime config.
paragraphs.zh: 已经在运行的已采用会话可能需要重启才能应用新写入的运行时配置。

paragraphs.en: For agents: First ask which available provider(s) the user wants, reusing an explicit choice, and pass it to setup ( rig setup --providers claude , codex or both ). Recommend the working account they already have and follow the selected-provider guide above. Offer core setup ( rig setup ) or the fuller workstation path ( rig setup --full ) only when they want those additional tools. Inspect the result with --json and use rig doctor to finish any remaining machine-specific issues. Starting OpenRig and opening its view are the last steps of installing, not extras, so do them without stopping to ask whether to go on: start the daemon if it is stopped, open the OpenRig TUI and operator for them (say so, then run rig terminal open saved:kernel --window --json ; no commands for the person to copy), and hand the person's goal and project folder to the kernel operator ( installing-agent handoff ). Installation is finished when the person is talking to the operator; don't implement the project yourself. When OpenRig itself misbehaves, read docs/reference/help.md (installed agents can run rig context get help ; the same text is at openrig.dev/help/agents ): it covers the next step, known problems, and how to reach the team if you're still stuck.
paragraphs.zh: 对于智能体：首先询问用户想要哪些可用的提供方，复用其明确的选择，并将其传递给 setup（运行 rig setup --providers claude、codex 或两者）。 推荐他们已有的可用账户，并遵循上文所选提供方的指南。 仅当用户需要那些额外工具时，才提供核心安装（rig setup）或更完整的工作站路径（rig setup --full）。 使用 --json 检查结果，并使用 rig doctor 解决剩余的任何机器特定问题。 启动 OpenRig 并打开其视图是安装的最后步骤，而非额外操作，因此无需停下询问是否继续：如果守护进程已停止则启动它，为用户打开 OpenRig TUI 和操作器（先说明，然后运行 rig terminal open saved:kernel --window --json；无需让用户复制任何命令），并将用户的目标和项目文件夹交给内核操作器（installing-agent handoff）。 当用户开始与操作器对话时，安装即告完成；不要自己实现该项目。 当 OpenRig 本身出现异常时，请阅读 docs/reference/help.md（已安装的智能体可运行 rig context get help；相同文本也见 openrig.dev/help/agents）：其中涵盖了下一步操作、已知问题，以及在你仍然受阻时如何联系团队。
